text:
Alex (Customer): Hey, hitting a pretty sharp production bug — when we stream responses with function/tool calling enabled the tool args sometimes arrive as partial JSON and our tool process chokes with a parse error. Happened ~10% of requests. Trace id: rdw-req-8f3b.

Jen S.: Sorry — that sounds bad. Can you paste the exact streaming output you received (the last 2-3 chunks) and the client SDK/version? Also which model and endpoint?

Alex (Customer): Using the HTTP streaming endpoint with our custom SSE client (node-fetch streaming), model `gpt-infer-stream-2`, SDK: custom wrapper over node-fetch. Here's the last few bytes we got (redacted):

```
data: {"type":"token","token":"{\"action\":\"create_order\",\"args\":{\"order_id\":\"1234\",\"items\":[{\"sku\":\"X1\",\"qty\":1}],\"shipping\":{\"addr\":\"1 Main St\"}}}"}
data: {"type":"token","token":"}\n```

Alex (Customer): See how the closing brace comes as a separate token piece `}"` — sometimes the JSON is split across tokens and our parser tries to decode mid-stream. We only parse when we see the `tool_call` event finished but seems the SDK flags it earlier.

Tom R.: Are you receiving a dedicated `tool_call`/`function_call` event with `finished=true` or an explicit `end` event? If the client parses on every `token` event it can attempt to parse partial JSON. Also, does your wrapper reassemble tokens into the original string before JSON.parse?

Alex (Customer): We reassemble by appending token text to a buffer, then when the stream emits the `tool_call_complete` marker we do JSON.parse(buffer). But the problem looks like the `tool_call_complete` marker is emitted before the final token arrives. Repro steps:
1) Start streaming request with `response_mode: stream` and `allow_tool_calls: true`.
2) Wait for events.
3) Observe `tool_call` event with `args` field populated incrementally; sometimes `tool_call_complete` appears then the stream yields one more `token` event containing the closing brace.

Ops Bot: Gateway logs for rdw-req-8f3b: `stream_close: client_disconnect=false, last_event_sent=token, final_event_flag=false, flush_status=partial`

Maya K.: Thanks, this helps. Two hypotheses: (A) the server-side stream flush semantics sometimes send the ``tool_call_complete`` metadata before the token buffer is fully flushed to the chunk stream (race). (B) the client SSE parsing library treats `data:` lines as discrete events and our code path that emits `tool_call_complete` is triggered when the model's internal meta is ready but the final token hasn't been serialized into the outer chunk.

Jen S.: Can you share the full raw HTTP response (first ~1KB) including chunk boundaries (hex sizes) if possible? Chunking would confirm if the final '}' landed after a chunk boundary that the client ignored.

Alex (Customer): Attaching approximate raw: (we replaced binary with ascii)

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: text/event-stream

4e
data: {"type":"meta","event":"tool_call","name":"create_order"}

6a
data: {"type":"token","token":"{\"action\":\"create_order\",\"args\":{\"order_id\":\"1234\",\"items\":[{\"sku\":\"X1\",\"qty\":1}],\"shipping\":{\"addr\":\"1 Main St\"}}}"}

2
data: {"type":"token","token":"}\n
0

```

Alex (Customer): Notice the chunk sizes — the last chunk is standalone `}` but client sometimes sees `0` (end) before it processes that chunk.

Tom R.: That matches a race in some node streaming stacks where the final chunk arrives concurrently with the stream close event and some SSE parsers drop empty line sequences. Workarounds: (1) disable streaming for tool calls in the short term (`response_mode: sync` or `stream: false`), (2) buffer at the client until you see an explicit closing `tool_call` meta AND confirm the token buffer ends with a balanced JSON (simple heuristic: attempt a final parse; on error wait up to N ms for more bytes), (3) upgrade to our patched runtime once available.

Maya K.: We reproduced with our internal SSE harness against the same model and saw the final token occasionally sent in a separate chunk after the `tool_call_complete` meta due to the kernel flushing ordering. Root cause: our streaming metadata event gets emitted from the model compositor when the function-return signal is ready, but the token serializer flush uses a different queue; in high-throughput/low-latency cases the order can invert.

Jen S.: Escalating to eng-runtime. Assigning ticket RW-5642 high priority. Maya, can you propose a mitigation we can push ASAP that doesn't require a major protocol change?

Maya K.: Proposed mitigation (non-breaking): change the server to always send a final empty `meta` event `data: {"type":"meta","event":"tool_call_end"}\n` after the token stream flush completes, and ensure it's sent before final chunk/close. We'll also add a short (>5ms) flush barrier so the token serializer flushes before meta finalize in the hot path. This should be low-risk and backward-compatible (clients that already buffer ignore extra meta). Planning patch for next minor `eng-runtime` deploy (v2.6.1).

Tom R.: Can we also add a quick client-side bullet in support docs: "When using streaming + tool calls, assemble tokens to a buffer and only JSON.parse after receiving a `tool_call_complete` meta and validating balanced braces; if parse fails, wait up to 250ms for more bytes before failing" — that'll help customers while we roll the server fix.

Jen S.: Alex — temporary workaround: switch the endpoint to non-streaming for tool calls or add the parsing guard. If you want, we can enable a per-customer gating flag from the control plane to force the flush order change for your account earlier. Do you want that?

Alex (Customer): Yes please enable gating flag for rdw-org-79 — we have heavy traffic and can't disable streaming. Also I can add the client guard. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Ops Bot: Gate flag request recorded: gate-request-719, assigned to ops-team.

Maya K.: I'll follow up in eng-runtime channel with the code diff and rollout plan. We'll also add an automated test that simulates interleaved meta/token flush ordering to prevent regressions.

Jen S.: Marking this thread "escalated" and linking incident RW-5642. I'll update Alex when gate is enabled and when v2.6.1 is deployed.

Alex (Customer): Appreciate it — small ask: when gating is enabled can you send a sample curl streaming response so we can validate on our side?

Maya K.: Will send sample curl + raw chunked output in the eng-runtime channel once we've validated.

Tom R.: Added short note to support KB: "streaming tool-call partial JSON — client best practices" with the guard/heuristic.

Jen S.: Closing loop for now, keeping thread open until gate + patch landed. :thumbsup:
